Data & Methods
  • Visual: The starfield and outer scale marks are visual references only. Surface lights sample the existing interpolation grid; they add neither companies nor market observations. The Focus button / I key hides panels; all original layers and playback rules are retained.
  • Controls: Drag to rotate · Scroll to zoom · Click a company for three-layer readings · Space to play/pause · ← → step one day · 1/2/3 switch spaces · F restore view · H open panel. “Start 6-Step Tour” at lower left explains the sequence.
  • References: Based on Financial Market Simulation System Design Handbook v1.2: §03 three-layer space, §04 fixed anchors and price axes, §05 composite relation channels, §08/§10 information interfaces and time, and §15 geometric representation. Visuals and data come from the companion works How Price and Value Align, Value–Price Planet, Spatial Dynamics Observatory, Asset Universe, and Financial Information Ecosystem.
  • Data: 33 AI infrastructure companies, 2023-01-03 — 2026-10-13 (948 trading days), from the embedded payload in the reference page Value–Price Planet: market-cap shares update daily and technical-value shares quarterly.
  • Height: r = 1 + gain · ln(share × N); a share of 1/N lies on the base surface. Sliders change display only, not values.
  • Two Surfaces: Gaussian-kernel interpolation between company nodes is for spatial display only; it is neither a tradable price nor a quote between observed times.
  • Information: Public news illuminates nodes simultaneously and decays by similarity, without ripples spreading from the source. Only channel information—such as a relationship itself becoming news—travels along relation edges. Animation speed is not an empirical time lag.
  • Relations: 37 disclosed relationships appear on their disclosure dates. The outer layer is a composite channel with independent types inside. Thickness does not represent scale.
  • Boundaries: Technical-value share ≠ monetary fair value. After controlling for similarity, relationships add no price-layer increment for routine news. Spillover and subsequent reversal of basket flows are first-round empirical findings (Handbook §23A/§23B/§24A). Geometric distance does not represent transmission time, cost, or probability. MU vs is negative from 2023-12 to 2024-03 (negative gross margin); original values are retained and flagged in readings. Cloud capex for 2026Q3/Q4 is not covered and is forward-filled from 2026Q2 for display.
